paper_style.palette_strategy: 主文以阶段色（蓝 ID retrieval、红 ID selection、绿 feature retrieval）和 position/feature 曲线色建立机制语义；行为柱图另用灰度或低饱和色，刺激图用颜色×形状组合表达 feature entropy。色彩常与文字、面板位置或线型冗余，但 heatmap/sweep 的色相区分在灰度下不安全。
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: LaTeX/pdfTeX 双栏排版；线图、柱图、箭头和文字主要为 vector，刺激照片、形状图、PCA atlas、CMA heatmap 和 schematic icon 为 raster，整体为 mixed。PDF object inspection found raster images on pp.4, 7, 9, 14–15, 17–18, 21–23, 29 and vector chart primitives elsewhere.
paper_style.style_consistency: caption/正文使用 Nimbus Roman No9 L 与 Computer Modern math，图内统计轴/legend 多为 DejaVu Sans/Open Sans Bold，prompt 与 schematic label 使用 Nimbus Mono L/Courier New；三阶段色块和 RSA 色彩在主文与附录稳定复用。主要不一致来自各模型附录图的轴范围、色条尺度和极密小字体，而非排版结构。

figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1: Overview of position ID architecture and supporting evidence. We identify three processing stages: ID retrieval heads that retrieve the position ID of objects described in the prompt, ID selection heads that select the position ID for a target object, and feature retrieval heads that use this position ID to retrieve the features of the target object. These stages are revealed both by (b,c) representational and (d) causal mediation analyses (see text for explanation).

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: 主文 Figure 1 先给出三阶段 position-ID architecture 与 PCA/RSA/CMA 接口，Figure 2 检验 relative/absolute coding，Figure 3–5 以 PUG、patch-key 和跨任务 intervention 做因果行为验证，Figure 6–7 将 entropy 与 binding failure 连接。附录按数据设计→CMA 条件→全模型 representation/CMA→空间编码→entropy→K/α sweep→COCO→counting→activation patch table 展开，形成“机制接口→表征→局部因果→任务与失败边界”的单一视觉叙事。

cross_object_system.table_header_system: 唯一 Table 1 使用两级表头：Model、High Entropy、Low Entropy 下的 No/With Intervention 与 Improvement；LLaVA/Qwen 行分组以横线隔开。两位百分比精度统一、无高亮和颜色，表头明确了干预条件但未定义 improvement 的单位或不确定性。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figure 1 的三类 head 通过 Figures 10–12 的 CMA conditions 和 Figures 20–25 的 layer×head heatmaps 定位；Figures 3–5/30/46 将定位转成 stage-specific intervention，Figures 38–44 扫描 K/α，Figure 47 用 top-vs-bottom ablation 检验 downstream counting。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: 正文 Figures 1–7 是最小机制论证；Appendix Figures 8–13 给 stimulus/CMA/intervention protocol，14–25 给模型和 head 全量，26–30 给 PCA/RSA/position coding 扩展，31–44 给 entropy 与 hyperparameter robustness，45–47 和 Table 1 给 COCO、counting、binding-error causal boundary。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: PDF font objects show Nimbus Roman No9 L/Medium、Nimbus Mono L、DejaVu Sans、Open Sans Bold 与 Computer Modern math；正文/caption 的衬线体系稳定，图内 sans/mono 标签角色稳定。附录 heatmap 与 sweep 的字号降到约 3.5–6 pt，虽保持字体体系但降低可读性。
